study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative modeling of brain morphometry in self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The devCCNP dataset (developing Chinese Color Nest Project) provided normative training data from two centers (CKG sample and PEK sample), comprising 457 healthy children. A single-site case-control cohort from Jinling Hospital provided 187 children with SeLECTS and 108 healthy controls for clinical application of the normative model.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The data for model training consists of two samples: the CKG sample and the PEK sample. Samples from the two different centers are both sourced from the developing Chinese Color Nest Project (devCCNP)." ... "The current work encompassed two independent cohorts: a case-control cohort and a normal sample for model training."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Yang2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Participants, L40-L46

answer.devCCNP: normative model training (457 healthy children from CKG and PEK centers)

answer.SINGLE-SITE: transfer for clinical research (187 SeLECTS patients and 108 age- and sex-matched healthy controls from Jinling Hospital)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The devCCNP data (CKG + PEK samples) were used exclusively to train sex-specific normative models for subcortical volume, cortical thickness, and surface area using the CentileBrain framework. The single-site case-control cohort from Jinling Hospital was used to apply the trained normative models and assess individual deviations in SeLECTS children versus matched healthy controls.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "These normal data comprise two samples: the CKG sample and the PEK sample. The two samples were combined to train the normative models" ... "We have developed sex-specific normative models on regional subcortical volume, cortical thickness, and surface area data from 457 healthy children sourced from two datasets. These models were then utilized to map the brain morphometric deviations of children with Self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes (n = 187) and sex- and age-matched healthy controls (n = 108) from another dataset."

model-1.model-name: CentileBrain-based sex-specific normative model (subcortical volume, cortical thickness, surface area)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single normative modeling framework was applied using all 457 healthy individuals from devCCNP for training. The paper does not describe a separate validation or test split from the normative training data; the 108 HCs from the case-control cohort were used for comparison purposes but not for normative model construction. The overall-phase and train-phase are considered equivalent because all 457 participants were used for model construction.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "normative models for each regional morphometric measure were developed utilizing data from a multisite sample of 457 healthy individuals (47.3% female; aged 3 to 18 years) from the devCCNP."

Since all normative data were used for training without a separate test split, overall-phase and train-phase values are identical. Age unit is years.
